item: CURRENT.md 2026-10-19 OWNER PAUSE resume queue (b): fill pacing/deferral on the packet176c line

premise.text: p176 readout shows ~1.0 ms/token of wall outside the transfer window (fill cost moved)
premise.arithmetic: (wall slope 0.06656 - transfer slope 0.03488) ms/MB x 30.63 MB/token = 0.970 ms/token
premise.origin: pre-device packet176 README pricing on packet58as/171b/174 spin streams; the device readout printed at 12:00Z carried no B-view slope; the resume-queue line was written 5 minutes later from the pre-device number
premise.why_not_a_fill_cost: the slopes are fitted over FILLED tokens only; unfilled tokens show the same outside-transfer slope against the NEXT token's fill bytes (0.03206 vs 0.03168 ms/MB on packet171b A1): fill bytes track miss intensity (fills are planned from the previous positions' misses, misses are autocorrelated), and that slope prices the misses themselves, not the fills. packet176's moved_rule fires on packet171b too, where nothing moved.

a_line.source: packet171b real spin streams (A1/A2 = packet58as spin/copy configuration)

packet176_bracket.source: coordinator session transcript 9743941a-5875-4449-b2f0-62a6e15d94f5, tool result at 2026-10-19T12:00:13.424Z (mechanism_readout views of card0-176-v5-a WSCREEN summary.json, digest ad74c8efd7b4984bddffadc36e8c88f54357381ae4ffadd3920f7998458ce9e3)

b_line.meaning: if fills became completely free on the kernel-I/O line (impossible: ~61 MB per filled token still crosses PCIe)

why: pacing/deferral moves the same bytes; packet174: total bytes, not their placement, set the cost (fill kick -0.02%)
on the B line 94% of the removed transfer wait already became wall gain: fills overlap compute
the remaining filled-token excess may be publication staleness (more misses on the stale-table position), which pacing cannot touch

do_not_repeat: packet174: do not pace or re-time fills inside the token while they show zero absorption (total bytes set the cost)
packet171b: reopen foreground-copy moves only together with a change to fill scheduling or volume
packet174: tune admission only once fills overlap compute (now true on the B line, but fills ~free => only prefetch helps)

decision.rule: brief rule 8: a chain only at >= +2% expected gain
